crossRefs.note: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life…
lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name, I cut them off.
many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.
They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you”, says Yahweh, “to rescue you.”
Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea…
I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail…
What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more.
If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’
The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.
The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.
For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”
Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds…

translations.web: They didn’t prevail. No place was found for them any more in heaven.
translations.bsb: But the dragon was not strong enough, and no longer was any place found in heaven for him and his angels.
translations.kjv: And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.
translations.asv: And they prevailed not, neither was their place found any more in heaven.
